Walk with certitude through the provinces of uncertainty. Hold firmly to the knowledge that you know nothing, and there is nothing to be held by knowing. Believe unambiguously that what's true can be traced any which way and is as ambiguous as the right way to get home, yet as certain and safe as the house and the key. Faith, wisdom and humility, the Trinity and triple gem of walking whispers, the touchstone of loving sight.
